name: conduit
description: Pairs this session with a companion session on the same Claude account: the companion reads capped digests of your turns and answers with cards (suggest, note, ask) in a sidebar tab, never in the transcript

peer.title: Companion session (leave empty to name it with /conduit on)
peer.description: The companion session's name as the native peer list shows it: another session on this machine, or a Remote Control session on the same Claude account.

startPaired.title: Pair with the companion when a session starts (leave off)
startPaired.description: On: every new session pairs with the companion session above by itself, in the mode below. Off: pair with /conduit on.

mode.title: Mode a pairing starts in: on-call or watch (leave as on-call)
mode.description: on-call keeps digests here and sends them only when you press Ask or run /conduit ask; watch sends one at each turn end, and one for your prompt while the session works on it (see below). Autopilot is never started from here: run /conduit autopilot.

promptDigest.title: Send your prompt to the companion while the session works on it (turn off to send only at turn end, cheaper)
promptDigest.description: In watch, your prompt goes to the companion 20 seconds into the turn, so it can correct a prompt that will mislead the session; a turn that ends sooner carries it in its turn-end digest. Off: one digest per turn, at its end.

autopilotTurns.title: Prompts autopilot may send before it stops (0 for no cap)
autopilotTurns.description: Autopilot stops after the companion has sent this many prompts. 0 never stops it by count.

autopilotPermissions.title: Permission dialogs during autopilot: stop or approve (leave as stop)
autopilotPermissions.description: stop ends autopilot and leaves the dialog to you; approve allows the tool call and goes on. With approve and no cap, the session runs tools unattended until the companion says done.
